verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's GitHub repo confirms it is open source under the AGPL-3.0 license, with community discussion also confirming this (including implications of AGPL forking rights). Source is publicly readable on GitHub with an OSI-approved-family open license. Missing for 10: no evidence of clarity on which parts of the cloud-only features are excluded from the open license, and no independent audit of full repo completeness.
